text:
maya (AE): Hey team — just received CatalystProof's RFI. They attached a capability matrix + security questionnaire. Asking for POC options (onprem/VPC), HSM/KMS support, perf targets, and commercial tiers. Can we triage?
alex (SE): Uploaded the raw RFI PDF to our drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/sales/catalystproof/rfi.pdf
sophia (Sales Eng): Quick q — do they need embeddings + chat? Their RFI lists both but unclear if embeddings are batched or real-time. Sam, can you confirm?
sam (CatalystProof): We want embeddings for search (batch nightly) and a chat endpoint for customer support (real-time). Target 75ms 95p latency for chat.
jonah (Solutions): 75ms 95p on what hardware? If they're expecting hosted we should propose Dedicated with autoscaling. For on-prem we'll need quantization/FP16 guidance.
alex (SE): For Hosted/Dedicated: propose two POC tiers: 1) Proof-of-concept (2 wks, 100k tokens free, eval metrics) 2) Pilot (4 wks, dedicated pool reservation, benchmark tests). Pricing sketch: POC free tier, Pilot reserved baseline $12k/mo + usage overage.
maya (AE): Erin — any legal gotchas re: on-prem with customer-managed HSM? They asked for attestation reports and an enclave option.
erin (Legal): We can provide SOC2 report and customer onboarding checklist. HSM attestations — we rely on customer KMS/HSM; for Private deployments we require an MSA addendum. I'll draft language.
sophia (Sales Eng): I'll draft the capability matrix answers. Starting with a compact row for the model support matrix:

```
Feature | Redwood | Notes
Embeddings | Yes | Batch + realtime, token pricing per 1k
Chat (low latency) | Yes | Dedicated pool recommended, 75ms 95p target depends on model/seq len
On‑prem | Yes | Private package + KMS integration, pen test required
HSM/KMS | Integration | Bring-your-own supported; HSM vendor list in attachments
SLOs & SLAs | Optional | SLA for Dedicated, add-on for Private
```

maya (AE): Nice. Sophia - can you link to the HSM vendor list? We should include recommended quantization profiles for onprem.
jonah (Solutions): Putting a quick ops note: for their expected chat QPS (~30 qps peak), recommend 2x gpus in dedicated mode with autoscaling threshold at 60% util. Include batching window config: `max_batch_delay_ms=15`.
alex (SE): For perf testing during Pilot, we'll run the following command to generate the load test: `loadgen --target 75 --qps 30 --seq_len 128 --model redwood-13B-quant` — capture latency percentiles and token throughput.
sophia (Sales Eng): I'm populating the security questionnaire answers. Two asks from RFI: 1) data residency & encryption 2) pen test / vuln disclosures. Draft answers: "Data at rest encrypted via customer KMS; in transit TLS1.2+; we can arrange pen test report under NDA."
erin (Legal): Add: we require a letter to proceed for pen test report release and a short NDA amendment for vulnerability details.
maya (AE): Sam — what's your POC timeline goal? They asked for a kickoff next week in the RFI.
sam (CatalystProof): Ideally kickoff next Wed. We can provide a small dataset (anonymized) and one SSO account for testing.
jonah (Solutions): Ok — we can stand up a Pilot env in 5 business days if Dedicated capacity is available. I'll own infra setup and bench scripts.
alex (SE): I'll prepare cost estimate + line items for Pilot: reserved capacity, extra egress, observability retention, security add-ons. ETA EOD tomorrow.
sophia (Sales Eng): I'll attach a short eval checklist and a minimal prompt set for regressions: https://drive.redwood.internal/sales/catalystproof/eval-checklist.md
maya (AE): Please add a short note in the capability matrix clarifying fallback policies (model fallback to smaller variant in constrained times). Customer asked about graceful degradation.
jonah (Solutions): Also flag compatibility note: if they want HSM-backed key rotations we need a week to configure and test with their vendor HSM.
erin (Legal): I'll prepare MSA addendum language and a template SOW for the Pilot.
sophia (Sales Eng): Draft capability matrix uploaded: s3://redwood-sales/catalystproof/capability-matrix.csv — folks review and comment.
alex (SE): Looking at the security Qs: they want clarifications on employee background checks and sysadmin access controls. We should state RBAC, MFA, and least‑privilege for ops.
maya (AE): I'll assemble a single RFI response package: capability matrix, security answers, pricing appendix, and attach benchmark plan. Target to send to customer Friday.
sam (CatalystProof): Friday works. One more ask — can you include sample SLA targets for Pilot? uptime and response time targets.
jonah (Solutions): Draft SLA for Pilot: 99.5% uptime for Dedicated, latency SLOs measured on our loadgen during agreed windows. I'll draft and share.
sophia (Sales Eng): Quick note: include our Optimize suggestions in appendix (batching, cache TTLs, quant recommendations) — usually helps reduce cost by ~30% in pilot.
alex (SE): FYI price anchor for Pilot reserved baseline may vary by region. Maya, confirm region (US-WEST preferred by customer).
maya (AE): Confirmed — US-WEST.
erin (Legal): One compliance note: if they require audit logs retention >1yr we need to scope storage/surcharge.
maya (AE): Good catch. Add to pricing appendix.
sophia (Sales Eng): All action items: Sophia - capability matrix + attachments (in progress). Alex - pricing appendix (ETA tomorrow EOD). Jonah - bench & infra (owns). Erin - MSA addendum & pen test NDAs. Maya - assemble and send Friday.
team reaction: :thumbsup:
